name: litigation-workbench
description: Seven business litigation workflows, including adversarial argument review, case treatment and a Shepard’s handoff.

interface.longDescription: Build a proof matrix, prepare an exhibit-linked deposition, reconcile a demand, design a Lexis research assignment, audit a brief, check case treatment, or pressure-test an argument with an independent reviewer. Works with the sources the attorney supplies. The plugin contains written workflows and adds no external connections.
defaultPrompt: Pressure-test my argument. Show the original, a written steelman, and a fresh adversarial review at xhigh.
Reconcile this demand to the ledger and identify any unsupported payment triggers.
Can I still cite this case for the proposition in my brief? Check later treatment and list what I should Shepardize.
